reuseDecision: Existing Next dependency/build technology is a bounded reuse candidate only. No Vercel project/deploy/DNS authorization proved; no legacy UI or product code copied

minimumContracts.producer: Auth Invite owning reader + Native route Writer
minimumContracts.requirement: Opaque invite reference only; fetch current status through existing server authority after normal login, explicit Claim consent, no name/email matching or token/PII in logs
minimumContracts.missing: C04 directed registered Claim is not public link/QR authority; public landing/read/expiry context port still unqualified

minimumContracts.requirement: Qualified actual bundle+allowed route/origin; QA variants sharing scheme must not silently select another App/Session. No Guest draft loss or automatic Adoption on return
minimumContracts.missing: Native invite route, associated domains and actual approved TestFlight link/context recovery

minimumContracts.requirement: Use existing normal Auth and Source/Custody/Review/Admission; stable upload operation/hash/receipt, authorize target Trip/Item, explicit Review before Save
minimumContracts.missing: Qualified Web upload/context port and scope; no second parser, storage authority or automatic association

minimumContracts.requirement: Use formally approved mobile privacy/deletion/support source; no invented terms or old Web policy assumption
minimumContracts.missing: Approved public copy/support channel and publication/domain permission

boundaries: Only existing Next package metadata read in legacy repo; no legacy UI/env/Production
No new website, deployment, paid service, DNS or public link created
Invitation context is not authentication or membership; no Session/Keychain transfer
No open redirect or arbitrary callback; current OAuth redirect allowlist stays separate
Unknown expiry/start-date/reconnect policy not inferred from device time
